inputs.generation: Use pinned sample generators described in data.json.

anchor_workload.rule: Run published baseline configuration for anchors; use separate fixed representative configuration for timing.

outputs: Printed configuration: GPU count, option count, path count
Final Test passed / Test failed! verdict

scoring_interface.timing: Report streamed Total time (ms.) for fixed representative workload.
scoring_interface.accuracy: Check anchors.json on published 8192-option case; retain exit status.
scoring_interface.reserve: Sum Confidence / abs(MC-BS) only when error > 1e-6; divide by full option count. Confidence is discounted 1.96-standard-error width.
scoring_interface.L1: sum(abs(BS-MC))/sum(abs(BS)); record only, no published numeric acceptance target.
scoring_interface.rounding: Strict reserve > 1; at six-decimal printed boundary use verdict or recompute unrounded statistic.

timeout_policy: One fixed representative scale; no scale search or doubling PATH_N. Report timeout if budget exceeded.
runtime_estimate_reason: No published runtime for this representative scale or verified stock GPU. Completion within default budgets remains unverified.
repeat_count_reason: No repeat count specified by supplied source; record individual timings and environment, do not invent a published repetition rule.
